tables.name: player
tables.purpose: A person with an account: plays characters, may run campaigns.
business: An account is never deleted while it runs a campaign.

fields.name: email
fields.purpose: Where the invitations and the session recaps go.
business: Confirmed before the first campaign is joined.

tables.name: campaign
tables.purpose: A story a group plays over many sessions.
business: A campaign has exactly one game master.

fields.name: name
business: Unique among the game master's campaigns.

fields.name: game_master_id
business: The game master is also a member.

fields.name: started_on
fields.purpose: The first session's date, once played.

fields.name: archived
fields.purpose: Over: kept for the record, closed to changes.

tables.name: membership
tables.purpose: Who sits at a campaign's table.

tables.name: character
tables.purpose: A hero a player plays in one campaign.
business: At most one living character per player and campaign.
At most 6 characters in a campaign.

fields.name: player_id
business: The player is a member of the campaign.

fields.name: class
fields.purpose: Their class, which sets the hit dice and the spells.

fields.name: level
business: Rises only after a played session.

fields.name: hit_points
business: 0 means unconscious, not dead: death saves decide.

fields.name: max_hit_points
fields.purpose: The ceiling a long rest restores.

fields.name: inspiration
fields.purpose: The game master's reward for good role-play — planned, not yet in the database.

tables.name: item
tables.purpose: A thing that can be carried: the catalogue, shared by every campaign.

fields.name: magical
business: A magical item needs attunement when the rulebook says so.

tables.name: inventory_entry
business: The total weight stays under 15 × strength.

fields.name: equipped
fields.purpose: Worn or wielded, not just carried.

fields.name: state
business: A played session cannot go back to planned.

fields.name: summary
fields.purpose: The recap sent to the players.
business: Written by the game master within a week.

tables.name: rule_reference
tables.purpose: Where a rule is written in the books — planned for the rules helper.

links.purpose: The item's rules, page and paragraph.
